name: Mixed-carbohydrate DM29 (perturbed-gut-mimic medium) (PMC11358386)
organism_scope: Clostridioides difficile and human gut commensal bacteria community
description: Mixed-carbohydrate DM29 (perturbed-gut-mimic medium) — a defined medium extracted from Sulaiman et al. (2024). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Sulaiman et al. Elucidating human gut microbiota interactions that robustly inhibit diverse Clostridioides difficile strains across different nutrient landscapes. Nature Communications (2024). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-024-51062-w. [PMC11358386]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: To mirror a perturbed human gut, we modified DM29 by supplementing with 2 g/L of glucose, sorbitol, mannitol, trehalose, succinate, galactose, GalNAc, GlcNAc and sialic acid (mixed carbohydrate media)). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.verification_evidence: To mirror a perturbed human gut, we modified DM29 by supplementing with 2 g/L of glucose, sorbitol, mannitol, trehalose, succinate, galactose, GalNAc, GlcNAc and sialic acid (mixed carbohydrate media).
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.notes contains 'Extracted from the primary paper'

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
